title: Preparing an exec
hints: Look the tool up with the lookPath function you're given (in real code, exec.LookPath) and wrap its error.
argv[0] is the program's name as the user typed it, followed by the arguments: append([]string{tool}, args...).
For the environment, replace KEY=... entries in place when extra has that key, and append the remaining extra keys in sorted order (slices.Sorted(maps.Keys(extra))).
